'''Prefsbelt IV''', also referred to as simply '''Prefsbelt''',<ref name="Warfare" /> was a green [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Prefsbelt system/Legends|Prefsbelt system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was notably the site of the ancient [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic]]&mdash;and later [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]]&mdash;[[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Naval Academy]].

==History==
The name "Prefsbelt" originated as a corruption of [[Prefid's Belt]], a [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]] visible from the planet [[Fedje]] that included the Prefsbelt system's [[Prefsbelt's sun|star]]. Prefsbelt IV was first discovered by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizens fleeing the tyrannical [[Pius Dea]] cult in the [[11,600s BBY]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]] of the anti-Pius Dea [[Renunciates]] later discovered the colony and made it a Renunciate stronghold.

After the Pius Dea's defeat at the [[Battle of Uquine]] in [[10,966 BBY]], Pradeux and his fellow officers met on Prefsbelt IV to restructure and reorganize the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Republic Naval Academy]] was soon established on the planet at [[Castle Pradeux]]. Prefsbelt became a world with a naval tradition to rival that of [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]].

The Academy's location was kept secret for millennia, but even after it became common knowledge, its location was still officially classified. The Academy became the Imperial Naval Academy under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], serving as the premier institution of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and one of the three primary schools in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system.<ref name="Warfare" />
